title: XamlContrast --json report, schemaVersion 6
description: Frozen in 1.0. Every field is always present (null when it has no value, [] or {} when empty). Within 1.x fields are only added, never renamed or removed, and an addition does not change schemaVersion: consumers must ignore fields they do not know. Fields written as an enum are closed sets (a new value is a breaking change); fields described as an open set may gain values in 1.x and consumers must accept values they do not know. A breaking change raises schemaVersion and the major version.

toolVersion.description: Tool version without build metadata; null when the report was produced through the library rather than the CLI.

exitCode.description: The audit verdict: 0 pass, 1 pairs below the gate, 3 the result cannot be trusted. An output-file error afterwards still exits 2. Null outside the CLI.

paletteMode.description: Which palette detection path ran. An open set: a 1.x release may add a value (a new detection path), so consumers must accept values they do not know. Current values: `pair`, `csharp`, `single`, `none`.

paletteDegraded.description: Palette detection degraded: no palette found (hard-coded colours only) or the themes could not be told apart. --strict-palette turns this into exit 3. false when the config chose mode none.

failOn.description: The gate in effect (flag > config > default): warn = every pair below AA fails the run; fail = only pairs below the fail line. An open set: a 1.x release may add a gate, so consumers must accept values they do not know. Current values: `warn`, `fail`.

coverage.description: Percentage of pairs resolved, one decimal (half away from zero). The --min-coverage floor compares this same value.

file.description: Relative to the scanned root, forward slashes.

value.description: The value that blocked resolution: the background's raw value when the background is the problem, the palette key for unknown-palette-key, otherwise the foreground's raw value.

fg.description: The foreground as written in the source (a ' ×<opacity>' suffix when an element opacity applies).

bg.description: The resolved backdrop: '{Key}', '#RRGGBB', or a composite description.

ratioDark.description: Contrast ratio in the dark theme; null when the pair exists in the light theme only (theme is "light").

ratioLight.description: Contrast ratio in the light theme; null when the pair exists in the dark theme only (theme is "dark").

colors.description: Added in 1.1 (schemaVersion stays 6). The two opaque colours each theme's ratio was computed on: the foreground already composited over the backdrop with its own alpha and the accumulated Opacity, the backdrop with its translucent layers composited — what is on screen. A theme is null exactly when its ratio is null.

threshold.description: 0 for decorative elements, largeText or normalText otherwise.

symmetry.description: Only for fail and warn; null otherwise.

fontSize.description: FontSize in device-independent pixels (1/96 inch), converted the way WPF's FontSizeConverter does: a plain number is DIP; a unit suffix px, in (96), cm (96/2.54) or pt (96/72) is converted. Not rounded. null when no FontSize is set or it cannot be read statically (a resource reference, a binding).

theme.description: The one theme this pair exists in (a style in a one-theme dictionary, or a style key resolved per theme); the other theme's ratio is null. null when the pair exists in both. An open set: a 1.x release may add a theme (high contrast, say), so consumers must accept values they do not know. Current values: `dark`, `light`.

baseline.description: With --baseline: the ratchet verdict for pairs the gate blocks; null otherwise.

fg.description: The text colour on screen, #RRGGBB in upper case.

bg.description: The backdrop colour on screen, #RRGGBB in upper case.

reason.description: Why a pair could not be resolved. An open set: a 1.x release may add a reason (a newly named blind spot), so consumers must accept values they do not know; existing values keep their spelling. Current values: `no-ancestor-background`, `bound-or-gradient`, `unknown-palette-key`, `translucent-uncomposited`, `same-brush-pair`, `over-sibling-content`, `in-style-template`.
